presets.title: Baseline PINN warm-up
presets.intent: Stable baseline run with no teacher supervision. Use this as the reference point for later comparisons.
presets.notes: Set sensible defaults before introducing any teacher-guided supervision. Confirm the loss curves decrease smoothly.

presets.title: Interior teacher points only
presets.intent: Isolate the effect of displacement supervision in the bulk of the domain.
presets.notes: Interior supervision usually gives only modest improvement on stress accuracy, because Neumann loading is the dominant unmet constraint.

presets.title: Load-patch teacher points only
presets.intent: Anchor displacement exactly where the traction enters the domain.
presets.notes: Load-patch supervision is typically the strongest single intervention for stress accuracy, because it directly corrects the Neumann residual near the traction.

presets.title: Fourier features for sharper stress
presets.intent: Reduce spectral bias when the stress field looks too smooth near the load patch.
presets.notes: Try sigma in [1.0, 2.0] for stress problems. Larger sigma encodes higher-frequency content but can introduce noise.

presets.title: Adaptive collocation
presets.intent: Concentrate collocation points where the PDE residual is largest.
presets.notes: Useful when the loss plateaus mid-training. Keep some uniform points so the network does not forget the rest of the domain.

presets.title: Refine the FEM mesh
presets.intent: Reduce discretization error in the structured FEM baseline.
presets.notes: Doubling cells per side roughly quarters interpolation error in smooth regions, at higher solve cost.
